questions.text: 2 μF संधारित्र की पट्टिकाओं P₁ तथा P₂ पर क्रमश: 25 V तथा – 25 V विभव है । पट्टिका P₁ पर आवेश होगा :
questions.text_english: The plates P₁ and P₂ of a 2 μF capacitor are at potentials 25 V and – 25 V respectively. The charge on plate P₁ will be :
questions.solution: The potential difference across the capacitor plates is V = 25 – (∓25) = 50 V. The charge Q = C × V = 2 × 10⁻⁶ F × 50 V = 100 × 10⁻⁶ C = 0.1 mC. Option A (0.02 mC) uses V = 10 V incorrectly. Option C and D give values in μC which are far too small. The correct answer is (B) 0.1 mC.

questions.text: किसी प्रोटॉन को बिंदु P₁ से बिंदु P₂ तक ले जाया गया है, ये दोनों बिंदु किसी विद्युत क्षेत्र में स्थित हैं । बिंदु P₁ और P₂ पर विभव क्रमश: – 5 V और + 5 V हैं । यह मानते हुए कि बिंदुओं P₁ और P₂ पर प्रोटॉन की गतिज ऊर्जाएँ शून्य हैं, तो प्रोटॉन पर किया गया कार्य है :
questions.text_english: A proton is taken from point P₁ to point P₂, both located in an electric field. The potentials at points P₁ and P₂ are – 5 V and + 5 V respectively. Assuming that kinetic energies of the proton at points P₁ and P₂ are zero, the work done on the proton is :
questions.solution: By the work-energy theorem, since kinetic energies at both points are zero, the net work done equals the change in potential energy. Work done on the proton W = q(V₂ – V₁) = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(+5 – (−5)) = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 10 = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁸ J. The positive work is done on the proton moving it from lower to higher potential. The answer is (B).

questions.text: आरेख में दर्शाए अनुसार तार के किसी 2.0 cm लंबे खंड से, जो y-अक्ष के अनुदिश रखा गया है, धनात्मक y-दिशा में 5.0 A धारा प्रवाहित हो रही है । इस खंड (परिपथ के भाग) के कारण बिंदु (3 m, 4 m, 0) पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र है :
questions.text_english: A 2.0 cm segment of wire, carrying 5.0 A current in positive y-direction lies along y-axis, as shown in the figure. The magnetic field at a point (3 m, 4 m, 0) due to this segment (part of a circuit) is :
questions.solution: Using the Biot-Savart law for a short segment: dB = (μ₀/4π) × (I dl × r̂)/r². The wire is along y-axis, current in +y direction (dl = dy ĵ). The field point is at (3, 4, 0), so r = 3î + 4ĵ (taking origin as mid-point of segment). The cross product dl × r̂ = ĵ × (3î + 4ĵ)/5 = (3/5)(ĵ × î) = –(3/5)k̂. The distance r = 5 m. dB = (10⁻⁷ × 5 × 0.02 × (−3/5))/25 k̂ ≈ – 0.24 × 10⁻⁹ T k̂ = –(0.24 nT)k̂. Option (C) is correct because the cross product of +y current direction and the displacement vector toward (3,4,0) gives the –k̂ direction.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा प्रतिचुंबकीय पदार्थ है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is a diamagnetic substance ?
questions.solution: Sodium chloride (NaCl) is a diamagnetic substance because all its electrons are paired, resulting in no net magnetic moment. Gadolinium is a ferromagnetic material at lower temperatures. Sodium is paramagnetic due to the unpaired electron in its outer shell. Copper chloride (CuCl₂) is paramagnetic due to the unpaired electron in Cu²⁺. Only NaCl has all electrons paired, making it diamagnetic. The correct answer is (D).

questions.text: कोई धारावाही वृत्ताकार पाश जिसका चुंबकीय आघूर्ण M है, किसी बाह्य चुंबकीय क्षेत्र B में ऊर्ध्वाधर तल में इस प्रकार निलंबित है कि इसका तल B के अभिलंबवत् है । इस पाश को B के लंबवत् अक्ष के परित: 45° पर घुर्णित कराने में किया गया कार्य किसके निकटतम है ?
questions.text_english: A current carrying circular loop of magnetic moment M is suspended in a vertical plane in an external magnetic field B such that its plane is normal to B. The work done in rotating this loop by 45° about an axis perpendicular to B is closest to :
questions.solution: Initially the plane of the loop is normal to B, which means the magnetic moment M is along B, so θ₁ = 0°. After rotating by 45° about an axis perpendicular to B, θ₂ = 45°. Work done W = MB(cosθ₁ – cosθ₂) = MB(cos0° – cos45°) = MB(1 – 1/√2) = MB(1 – 0.707) ≈ 0.293 MB ≈ 0.3 MB. The answer is (A) 0.3 MB.
questions.topic: Torque and work done on magnetic dipole

questions.text: किसी प्रत्यावर्ती वोल्टता v = (157 V) sin ωt का इसके प्रथम अर्ध-चक्र में औसत मान होगा :
questions.text_english: The average value of the alternating voltage v = (157 V) sin ωt over its first half-cycle is :
questions.solution: The average value of an alternating voltage v = V₀ sinωt over the first half-cycle is given by Vₐᵥᵲ = 2V₀/π. Here V₀ = 157 V, so Vₐᵥᵲ = 2 × 157 / π = 314 / 3.14 = 100 V. Option A (157 V) is the peak value. Option B is the rms value. Option C (78.5 V) is V₀/2. The correct answer is (D) 100 V.

questions.text: किसी एसी परिनालिका पर विचार कीजिए जिसकी लंबाई l, अनुप्रस्थ-काट क्षेत्रफल A तथा फेरों की संख्या नियत है । इस परिनालिका के स्वप्रेरकत्व में वृद्धि होगी यदि :
questions.text_english: Consider a solenoid of length l and area of cross-section A with fixed number of turns. The self-inductance of the solenoid will increase if :

options.A: l और A दोनों में वृद्धि हो
options.B: l में कमी और A में वृद्धि हो
options.C: l में वृद्धि और A में कमी हो
options.D: l और A दोनों में कमी हो

options_english.A: both l and A are increased
options_english.B: l is decreased and A is increased
options_english.C: l is increased and A is decreased
options_english.D: both l and A are decreased

questions.solution: The self-inductance of a solenoid is L = μ₀n²Al, where n = N/l is the turns per unit length. With N fixed, n = N/l, so L = μ₀(N/l)² × A × l = μ₀N²A/l. Therefore L is directly proportional to A and inversely proportional to l. To increase L, we need to increase A and decrease l simultaneously. The correct answer is (B).

questions.text: कोई समतल विद्युत-चुंबकीय तरंग +x दिशा में वायु में गमन कर रही है । किसी विशेष क्षण पर इसका विद्युत-क्षेत्र E, +y दिशा के अनुदिश है । उसी क्षण इसका चुंबकीय क्षेत्र B किस दिशा के अनुदिश है ?
questions.text_english: A plane electromagnetic wave is travelling in air in +x direction. At a particular moment, its electric field E is along +y direction. At that moment, the magnetic field B is along :

options.A: +z दिशा के अनुदिश तथा E के साथ कला में
options.B: –z दिशा के अनुदिश तथा E के साथ कला में
options.C: +z दिशा के अनुदिश तथा E के साथ कला में नहीं
options.D: –z दिशा के अनुदिश तथा E के साथ कला में नहीं

options_english.A: +z direction and in phase with E
options_english.B: –z direction and in phase with E
options_english.C: +z direction and out of phase with E
options_english.D: –z direction and out of phase with E

questions.solution: For an electromagnetic wave, E, B and the direction of propagation are mutually perpendicular and related by c = E/B. The direction of propagation is given by E × B. Here propagation is in +x direction and E is in +y direction. Using î = ĵ × k̂, we get B must be in +z direction so that ĵ × k̂ = î (i.e., +y × +z = +x). In a plane EM wave, E and B are always in phase. The answer is (A).

questions.text: समान वेग से गतिमान कोई प्रोटॉन और कोई एल्फा कण किसी लक्ष्य नाभिक पर उपगमन करते हैं । ये क्षणिक विराम में आते हैं और फिर अपनी दिशाओं को व्युत्क्रमित करते हैं । प्रोटॉन के उपगमन की निकटतम दूरी तथा एल्फा कण के उपगमन की निकटतम दूरी का अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: A proton and an alpha particle having equal velocities approach a target nucleus. They come momentarily to rest and then reverse their directions. The ratio of the distance of closest approach of the proton to that of the alpha particle will be :
questions.solution: At the distance of closest approach, all kinetic energy converts to electrostatic potential energy. KE = (1/2)mv² = kq·Z·e/r₀, so r₀ = kqZe/((1/2)mv²). For a proton: q = e, m = m_p. For an alpha particle: q = 2e, m = 4m_p. Since both have equal velocities: r_proton/r_alpha = (e × Z) / (2e × Z) × (4m_p v² / m_p v²) = (1/2) × 4 = 2. Wait, more carefully: r₀ = kqZe / KE = kqZe / (1/2 mv²). r_p = (k × e × Z·e) / (1/2 m_p v²) and r_α = (k × 2e × Z·e) / (1/2 × 4m_p × v²). Ratio r_p/r_α = (e / (m_p)) / (2e / (4m_p)) = (e/m_p) × (4m_p/2e) = 2. The correct answer is (B) 2.

questions.text: गतिज ऊर्जा K वाले इलेक्ट्रॉन से संबद्ध द्रव्य तरंग की तरंगदैर्घ्य λ है । यदि इलेक्ट्रॉन की गतिज ऊर्जा दो गुनी कर दी जाए, तो संबद्ध तरंगदैर्घ्य हो जाएगी :
questions.text_english: The wavelength of matter wave associated with an electron of kinetic energy K is λ. If the kinetic energy of the electron is doubled, the associated wavelength becomes :
questions.solution: De Broglie wavelength λ = h/p = h/√(2mK). So λ ∝ 1/√K. When kinetic energy becomes 2K, the new wavelength λ’ = h/√(2m×2K) = h/(√2 × √(2mK)) = λ/√2. Option A (λ/2) would require K to become 4K. Option B would mean wavelength increases, which contradicts the inverse relationship. The correct answer is (C) λ/√2.

questions.text: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु के बोर मॉडल में कोई इलेक्ट्रॉन n = 2 स्तर से n = 1 स्तर को संक्रमण करता है । इसके परिक्रमण काल में :
questions.text_english: An electron makes a transition from n = 2 level to n = 1 level in the Bohr model of a hydrogen atom. Its period of revolution :
questions.solution: In Bohr's model, the period of revolution T ∝ n³. At n = 2, T₂ ∝ 8 (units). At n = 1, T₁ ∝ 1 (unit). Percentage decrease = (T₂ – T₁)/T₂ × 100 = (8 – 1)/8 × 100 = 7/8 × 100 = 87.5%. The period decreases by 87.5% when the electron transitions from n = 2 to n = 1. The correct answer is (B).

questions.text: Si को एक पंचसंयोजी तत्व से अपमिश्रित किया गया है । अतिरिक्त इलेक्ट्रॉन को मुक्त करने के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा है लगभग :
questions.text_english: Si is doped with a pentavalent element. The energy required to set the additional electron free is about :
questions.solution: When silicon is doped with a pentavalent (donor) impurity, the fifth electron is very loosely bound to the donor atom. The energy required to set this extra electron free (ionization energy of the donor level) is very small, approximately 0.05 eV. Option A (0.01 eV) is too small. Options C (0.72 eV) and D (1.1 eV) refer to energy band gaps of Ge and Si respectively, not the donor ionization energy. The correct answer is (B) 0.05 eV.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : किसी अर्धचालक में, चालन बैंड में इलेक्ट्रॉनों की ऊर्जा संयोजकता बैंड में उनसे कम होती है ।
कारण (R) : किसी अर्धचालक में दाता ऊर्जा स्तर संयोजकता बैंड के ठीक ऊपर होता है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : In a semiconductor, the electrons in the conduction band have lesser energy than those in the valence band.
Reason (R) : Donor energy level is just above the valence band in a semiconductor.
questions.instruction_line: आगे दिए गए कोड (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है तथा कारण (R) भी गलत है

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is also false.

questions.solution: The Assertion is false: electrons in the conduction band have HIGHER energy than those in the valence band, not lower. The conduction band lies above the valence band separated by a band gap. The Reason is also false: the donor energy level in an n-type semiconductor lies just BELOW the conduction band (not above the valence band), making it easy for electrons to jump into the conduction band. Since both statements are false, the correct answer is (D).

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : प्रकाश-विद्युत प्रभाव प्रकाश की कणात्मक प्रकृति को निदर्शित करता है ।
कारण (R) : प्रकाश-विद्युत धारा आपतित विकिरणों की आवृत्ति के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : Photoelectric effect demonstrates the particle nature of light.
Reason (R) : Photoelectric current is proportional to frequency of incident radiation.
questions.instruction_line: आगे दिए गए कोड (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है तथा कारण (R) भी गलत है

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is also false.

questions.solution: The Assertion is true: the photoelectric effect demonstrates the particle (quantum/photon) nature of light because it shows light interacts as discrete packets of energy (photons) rather than as continuous waves. The Reason is false: photoelectric current is proportional to the INTENSITY (not frequency) of the incident radiation, as more intense light provides more photons that eject more electrons per second. The frequency affects the maximum kinetic energy of ejected electrons, not the current. Therefore (C) is correct.
questions.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक प्रोटॉन और एक इलेक्ट्रॉन समान संवेग p से इस प्रकार एकसमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र B में प्रवेश करते हैं कि p चुंबकीय क्षेत्र B के लंबवत् है । ये दोनों समान त्रिज्या के वृत्तीय पथ पर गमन करेंगे ।
कारण (R) : किसी चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में कक्षीय त्रिज्या r का मान p/(qB) के बराबर होता है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : A proton and an electron enter a uniform magnetic field B with the same momentum p such that p is perpendicular to B. They describe circular paths of the same radius.
Reason (R) : In a magnetic field, orbital radius r is equal to p/(qB).
questions.instruction_line: आगे दिए गए कोड (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है तथा कारण (R) भी गलत है

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is also false.

questions.solution: The Assertion is true: since both proton and electron have the same momentum p and the same magnitude of charge q = e, the radius r = p/(qB) = p/(eB) is the same for both. The Reason is also true and correctly explains the Assertion, since the formula r = p/(qB) directly shows that radius depends on momentum and charge, and with equal p and equal |q|, the radii are equal. The answer is (A).
questions.topic: Circular motion of charged particle in magnetic field

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : कोई उत्तल लेंस किसी द्रव में डुबोए जाने पर लुप्त हो जाता है ।
कारण (R) : लेंस के पदार्थ और द्रव दोनों के अपवर्तनांक समान हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : A convex lens, when immersed in a liquid, disappears.
Reason (R) : The refractive indices of material of the lens and the liquid are equal.
questions.instruction_line: आगे दिए गए कोड (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) गलत है
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है तथा कारण (R) भी गलत है

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is also false.

questions.solution: The Assertion is true: when a convex lens is immersed in a liquid whose refractive index equals that of the lens material, the lens loses its focusing power and effectively disappears optically. The Reason is also true and it correctly explains the Assertion, because by the lensmaker's equation, if the refractive indices of lens and surrounding medium are equal, the focal length becomes infinite, meaning no refraction occurs and the lens is invisible. The correct answer is (A).

questions.text: (H़) विद्युत चालक में मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉनों के विश्रांति काल से क्या अभिप्राय है ? यह दर्शाईए कि किसी चालक के प्रतिरोध को R = ml/(ne²τ) द्वारा व्यक्त किया जा सकता है, जहाँ प्रतीकों के अपने सामान्य अर्थ हैं ।

(a) What is meant by relaxation time of free electrons in a conductor? Show that the resistance of a conductor can be expressed by R = ml/(ne²τ), where symbols have their usual meanings.

OR

(b) Draw the circuit diagram of a Wheatstone bridge. Obtain the condition when no current flows through the galvanometer in it.

questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following

key_points: Relaxation time: average time between successive collisions of an electron with the lattice ions.
Drift velocity v_d = eEτ/m, current I = neAv_d = neAeEτ/m.
Using E = V/l and R = V/I, derive R = ml/(ne²τA).

questions.solution: Relaxation time (τ) is the average time interval between two successive collisions of a free electron with the positive ions of the conductor lattice. Under an applied electric field E, the drift velocity is v_d = eEτ/m. Current I = nAev_d = nAe(eEτ/m) = nAe²Eτ/m. Since E = V/l, we get I = nAe²Vτ/(ml). By Ohm's law R = V/I = ml/(nAe²τ), which is the required expression. Here m is electron mass, l is length, n is electron number density, A is cross-sectional area, e is electron charge.
questions.topic: Relaxation time and Ohm's law derivation

questions.text: किसी खगोलीय दूरदर्शक की आवधर्न क्षमता 24 है । सामान्य समायोजन में, इसके दो लेंसों के बीच की दूरी 150 cm है । अभिदृश्यक लेंस की फोकस दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: The magnifying power of an astronomical telescope is 24. In normal adjustment, distance between its two lenses is 150 cm. Find the focal length of the objective lens.

key_points: Magnifying power m = f_o/f_e = 24
Length of telescope L = f_o + f_e = 150 cm
Solving: f_o = 144 cm

questions.solution: For an astronomical telescope in normal adjustment, the magnifying power M = f_o/f_e = 24, and the tube length L = f_o + f_e = 150 cm. From the first equation, f_o = 24 f_e. Substituting: 24f_e + f_e = 150, so 25f_e = 150, giving f_e = 6 cm. Therefore the focal length of the objective lens is f_o = 24 × 6 = 144 cm.

questions.text: संतत (स्थायी) व्यतिकरण पैटर्न किसे कहते हैं ? इस प्रकार के व्यतिकरण पैटर्न को प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक शर्तें क्या हैं ?
questions.text_english: What is a sustained or stable interference pattern ? What are the conditions for obtaining such an interference pattern ?

key_points: Sustained interference: a pattern of bright and dark fringes that remains stationary over time.

Conditions: (1) The two sources must be coherent (constant phase difference). (2) The sources must emit light of the same frequency and wavelength. (3) The amplitudes of the waves should be equal or nearly equal for high contrast.

questions.solution: A sustained (stable) interference pattern is one in which the positions of bright and dark fringes remain fixed over time without fluctuating. For obtaining such a pattern, the two sources must be coherent, meaning they must maintain a constant phase difference with each other. Additionally, the two sources must emit light of the same frequency (and ideally the same wavelength), and the amplitudes of the superposing waves should be equal or comparable so that the dark fringes are nearly completely dark, ensuring good visibility of the pattern.

questions.text: तरंगदैर्घ्य 600 nm का प्रकाश पोटैशियम (कार्य-फलन 2.3 eV) पर आपतित होता है । क्या प्रकाश-विद्युत उत्सर्जन होगा ? वह सबसे लंबी तरंगदैर्घ्य ज्ञात कीजिए जो प्रकाश-विद्युत उत्सर्जन करेगी । (hc = 1240 eV.nm लीजिए)
questions.text_english: Light of wavelength 600 nm is incident on potassium (work function 2.3 eV). Will photoemission of electrons occur ? What is the longest wavelength that will cause photoemission of electrons ? (Take hc = 1240 eV.nm)

key_points: Energy of photon at 600 nm = 1240/600 ≈ 2.07 eV
Since 2.07 eV < 2.3 eV (work function), photoemission will NOT occur.
Threshold wavelength λ_max = hc/φ = 1240/2.3 ≈ 539 nm

questions.solution: Energy of the incident photon: E = hc/λ = 1240/600 ≈ 2.07 eV. Since 2.07 eV is less than the work function of potassium (2.3 eV), photoemission will not occur. The longest (threshold) wavelength that can cause photoemission corresponds to photon energy equal to the work function: λ_max = hc/φ = 1240/2.3 ≈ 539 nm. Any wavelength longer than 539 nm will not cause photoemission from potassium.
questions.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter

questions.text: मान लीजिए किसी शुद्ध Si क्रिस्टल में प्रति घन मीटर 5 × 10²⁸ परमाणु हैं । इसका मादन बोरॉन की 1 ppm सांद्रता द्वारा किया गया है । होलों की सांद्रता परिकलित कीजिए, दिया गया है ni = 1.5 × 10¹⁶ m⁻³ । यह मादित क्रिस्टल n-प्रकार का है अथवा p-प्रकार का, उल्लेख कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Suppose a pure Si crystal has 5 × 10²⁸ atoms m⁻³. It is doped by 1 ppm concentration of boron. Calculate the concentration of holes and electrons, given that ni = 1.5 × 10¹⁶ m⁻³. Is the doped crystal n-type or p-type ?

key_points: Hole concentration p_h = 1 ppm × 5×10²⁸ = 5×10²² m⁻³
Using nₙp_h = n_i²: electron concentration n_e = n_i²/p_h = (1.5×10¹⁶)²/(5×10²²) = 4.5×10⁹ m⁻³
Since boron is trivalent (acceptor), the crystal is p-type.

questions.solution: Boron is a trivalent (acceptor) impurity. The concentration of acceptor atoms (holes) is p_h = 1 ppm × 5 × 10²⁸ = 10⁻⁶ × 5 × 10²⁸ = 5 × 10²² m⁻³. Using the mass action law n_e × p_h = n_i², the electron concentration is n_e = n_i²/p_h = (1.5 × 10¹⁶)² / (5 × 10²²) = 2.25 × 10³² / 5 × 10²² = 4.5 × 10⁹ m⁻³. Since boron is an acceptor impurity and holes are the majority carriers, the doped crystal is p-type.

questions.text: जब किसी तार के सिरों पर 1.0 V विभवांतर अनुप्रयुक्त किया जाता है, तो उससे 1.6 A की धारा प्रवाहित होती है । इस तार की लंबाई 1.0 m तथा इसकी अनुप्रस्थ-काट का क्षेत्रफल 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ m² है । परिकलित कीजिए : (H़) तार के सिरों के बीच विद्युत क्षेत्र, (I) धारा घनत्व, (ग) औसत विश्रांति काल (मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या घनत्व 9.0 × 10²⁸ m⁻³ है)
questions.text_english: A current of 1.6 A flows through a wire when a potential difference of 1.0 V is applied across it. The length and cross-sectional area of the wire are 1.0 m and 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ m² respectively. Calculate: (a) Electric field across the wire, (b) Current density, (c) Average relaxation time. (Number density of free electrons in the wire is 9.0 × 10²⁸ m⁻³)

key_points: τ = mJ/(ne²E) ≈ 2×10⁻¹⁴ s

questions.solution: (a) Electric field E = V/l = 1.0 V / 1.0 m = 1 V/m. (b) Current density J = I/A = 1.6 / (1.0 × 10⁻⁷) = 1.6 × 10⁷ A/m². (c) Using the relation σ = ne²τ/m and J = σE, we get τ = mJ/(ne²E) = (9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 1.6 × 10⁷) / (9.0 × 10²⁸ × (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹)² × 1) = (1.456 × 10⁻²³) / (9.0 × 10²⁸ × 2.56 × 10⁻³⁸) = 1.456 × 10⁻²³ / 23.04 × 10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 6.3 × 10⁻¹⁴ s ≈ 2 × 10⁻¹⁴ s.
questions.topic: Electric field, current density, relaxation time

questions.text: इलेक्ट्रॉन (आवेश e, द्रव्यमान m) किसी हाइड्रोजन परमाणु में नाभिक की परिक्रमा त्रिज्या r के वृत्त में कर रहा है । कक्षीय कोणीय संवेग L के पदों में चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण μ_e के लिए सदिश रूप में व्यंजक व्युत्पन्न कीजिए । घूर्ण चुंबकीय अनुपात किसे कहते हैं ?
questions.text_english: An electron (charge e, mass m) is revolving around a nucleus, in a hydrogen atom, in a circle of radius r. Derive an expression, in vector form, for the magnetic dipole moment μ_e in terms of its orbital angular momentum L. What is gyromagnetic ratio ?

key_points: μ_e = (e/2m) L in vector form, with μ_e opposite to L since electron is negatively charged.
Gyromagnetic ratio = |μ_e|/|L| = e/(2m)

questions.solution: The electron revolves in a circle of radius r with speed v. The time period T = 2πr/v, so the equivalent current I = e/T = ev/(2πr). The magnetic moment μ_e = I × πr² = evr/2. The orbital angular momentum is L = mvr, so evr/2 = eL/(2m). In vector form, since electron carries negative charge, μ_e = –(e/2m)L. The ratio |μ_e|/|L| = e/(2m) is called the gyromagnetic ratio. It relates the magnetic moment to the orbital angular momentum of the electron.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि प्रेरित आवेश चुंबकीय फ्लक्स के नेट परिवर्तन पर निर्भर करता है, न कि फ्लक्स परिवर्तन के समय अंतराल पर ।
questions.text_english: Prove that induced charge depends on the net change in the magnetic flux and not on the time interval of the flux change.

key_points: Induced emf ε = –dΦ/dt
Induced current I = ε/R = –(1/R)(dΦ/dt)
Charge q = ∫I dt = –(1/R)∫ dΦ = –ΔΦ/R, depends only on ΔΦ not on time.

questions.solution: By Faraday's law, the induced emf is ε = –dΦ/dt. If R is the resistance of the coil, the induced current is I = ε/R = –(1/R)(dΦ/dt). The charge induced in time dt is dq = I dt = –(1/R) dΦ. Integrating over the total time of flux change from Φ₁ to Φ₂, the total induced charge is q = ∫ dq = –(1/R)∫Φ₁Φ² dΦ = –(Φ₂ – Φ₁)/R = –ΔΦ/R. This shows that the induced charge q depends only on the net change in magnetic flux (ΔΦ) and the resistance R, not on the time interval over which the change occurs.

questions.text:
निर्वात में किसी विद्युत-चुंबकीय तरंग के विद्युत क्षेत्र को इस प्रकार दिया गया है : E = (6.3 N/C) [cos (1.5 rad/m) y + (4.5 × 10⁸ rad/s) t] î
(क) तरंग की तरंगदैर्घ्य और आवृत्ति ज्ञात कीजिए । (ख) तरंग के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का आयाम क्या हनोगा ? (ग) इस तरंग के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के लिए व्यंजक लिखिए ।
questions.text_english:
The electric field in an electromagnetic wave in vacuum is given by:
E = (6.3 N/C) [cos (1.5 rad/m) y + (4.5 × 10⁸ rad/s) t] î
(a) Find the wavelength and frequency of the wave.
(b) What is the amplitude of the magnetic field of the wave?
(c) Write an expression for the magnetic field of this wave.
questions.solution: (a) From E = E₀ cos(ky + ωt)î, we identify k = 1.5 rad/m and ω = 4.5 × 10⁸ rad/s. Wavelength λ = 2π/k = 2π/1.5 ≈ 4.19 m. Frequency ν = ω/(2π) = 4.5 × 10⁸/(2π) ≈ 7.16 × 10⁷ Hz. (b) The amplitude of the magnetic field B₀ = E₀/c = 6.3/(3 × 10⁸) = 2.1 × 10⁻⁸ T. (c) The wave travels in the –y direction (since ky and ωt have the same sign). E is along î (+x direction). For the Poynting vector to point in –y direction, B must be along +z direction: B = (2.1 × 10⁻⁸ T) cos[(1.5)y + (4.5 × 10⁸)t] k̂.
questions.topic: EM wave equations, wavelength, frequency, magnetic field

questions.text: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु के लिए बोर के सिद्धांत का दूसरा अभिग्रहीत लिखिए । सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी हाइड्रोजन परमाणु की बोर कक्षा की त्रिज्या n² के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है, जहाँ n मुख्य क्वांटम संख्या है ।
questions.text_english: Write Bohr's second postulate for his theory of hydrogen atom. Prove that the radius of Bohr orbit of a hydrogen atom is directly proportional to n², where n is the principal quantum number.

key_points: Second postulate: The electron can revolve only in those orbits where angular momentum is an integral multiple of h/(2π).
From Coulomb force = centripetal force: mv²/r = ke²/r²
Using mvr = nh/(2π), eliminate v to get r = n²h²ε₀/(πme²), so r ∝ n².

questions.solution: Bohr's second postulate states that an electron can revolve only in those orbits in which its angular momentum is an integral multiple of h/(2π), i.e., mvr = nh/(2π), where n = 1, 2, 3, ... is the principal quantum number. To prove r ∝ n²: the centripetal force is provided by the Coulomb attraction, so mv²/r = ke²/r², giving mv² = ke²/r. From Bohr's second postulate, v = nh/(2πmr). Substituting: m[nh/(2πmr)]² = ke²/r, which gives r = n²h²/(4π²mke²). Since all other terms are constants, r ∝ n², proving the result.

questions.text: (क) परमाणु द्रव्यमान मात्रक (u) को परिभाषित कीजिए । (ख) किसी ड्यूटेरॉन को इसके अवयवों (प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन) में पृथक् करने के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा परिकलित कीजिए । दिया गया है : m(D) = 2.014102 u, m_H = 1.007825 u, m_n = 1.008665 u
questions.text_english:
(a) Define atomic mass unit (u).
(b) Calculate the energy required to separate a deuteron into its constituent parts (a proton and a neutron). Given: m(D) = 2.014102 u, m_H = 1.007825 u, m_n = 1.008665 u

key_points: 1 u = 1/12 of the mass of a carbon-12 atom = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
Binding energy = Δm × 931.5 MeV/u ≈ 2.224 MeV

questions.solution: (a) One atomic mass unit (u) is defined as one-twelfth of the mass of a carbon-12 atom. It equals approximately 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg or 931.5 MeV/c². (b) The mass defect for separating a deuteron is Δm = (m_H + m_n) – m(D) = (1.007825 + 1.008665 – 2.014102) u = 0.002388 u. The energy required (binding energy of deuteron) = Δm × 931.5 MeV/u = 0.002388 × 931.5 ≈ 2.224 MeV. This is the minimum energy needed to separate a deuteron into a free proton and a free neutron.
questions.topic: Atomic mass unit and binding energy

questions.text:
(क) किसी p-n संधि डायोड का V–I अभिलाक्षणिक प्राप्त करने के लिए परिपथ आरेख खींचिए । (i) अग्रदिशिक बायस और (ii) पश्चदिशिक बायस में V–I अभिलाक्षणिक के मुख्य लक्षणों की संक्षेप में व्याख्या कीजिए ।

(a) Draw the circuit diagrams for obtaining the V–I characteristics of a p-n junction diode. Explain briefly the salient features of the V–I characteristics in (i) forward biasing, and (ii) reverse biasing.

OR

(b) On the basis of energy band diagrams, distinguish between (i) an insulator, (ii) a semiconductor, and (iii) a conductor.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक प्रश्न हल कीजिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following

key_points: Forward bias: circuit with battery positive to p-side; current rises exponentially after threshold voltage (~0.7 V for Si).
Reverse bias: battery positive to n-side; only a very small reverse saturation current flows until breakdown.
For (b): insulator has large band gap (>3 eV), semiconductor has small gap (~1 eV), conductor has overlapping bands.

questions.solution: (a) In forward biasing, the positive terminal of the battery is connected to the p-side and negative to the n-side. Current begins to flow only after the external voltage exceeds the threshold (about 0.7 V for Si), beyond which current rises steeply. In reverse biasing, the battery polarity is reversed. Only a very small reverse saturation current (due to minority carriers) flows, which remains nearly constant until the breakdown voltage is reached, at which point current increases sharply. (b) In an insulator, the valence band is completely filled and the conduction band is empty with a large forbidden gap (>3 eV), so no conduction occurs. In a semiconductor, the band gap is small (~1.1 eV for Si), and at room temperature a few electrons are thermally excited to the conduction band, allowing limited conduction. In a conductor (metal), the conduction band and valence band overlap, so free electrons are always available for conduction.

questions.text: आरेख में समांतर सर्वसम चालक पट्टिकाओं के चार जोड़े, जिनमें सभी में पट्टिकाओं के बीच 2.0 cm दूरी का समान पृथकन है, x-अक्ष के लंबवत् व्यवस्थित किए गए हैं । प्रत्येक पट्टिका का विद्युत विभव अंकित है । पट्टिकाओं के किसी जोड़े के बीच विद्युत क्षेत्र एकसमान है तथा पट्टिकाओं के अभिलंबवत् है । (चार जोड़े: I (-70V, -50V), II (-50V, +150V), III (-20V, +200V), IV (-100V, -400V))
questions.text_english:
The figure shows four pairs of parallel identical conducting plates, separated by the same distance 2.0 cm and arranged perpendicular to x-axis. The electric potential of each plate is mentioned. The electric field between a pair of plates is uniform and normal to the plates.

Pairs: I (left: −70 V, right: −50 V), II (left: −50 V, right: +150 V), III (left: −20 V, right: +200 V), IV (left: −100 V, right: −400 V)
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित अनुच्छेदों को पढ़ कर दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Read the following paragraphs and answer the questions that follow.

sub_questions.text: पट्टिकाओं के किस जोड़े के लिए विद्युत क्षेत्र E, î के अनुदिश है ?
sub_questions.text_english: For which pair of the plates is the electric field along +î direction?
sub_questions.solution: Electric field points from higher potential to lower potential (from + to −). For the field to point in +î direction (i.e., from left to right, in +x direction), the right plate must be at lower potential than the left plate. Pair I: −50 > −70, so field points left (−x). Pair II: right plate +150 V > left plate −50 V, so field points from right to left, i.e., in −x direction? Wait: E = −dV/dx. For pair II, V increases from left (−50 V) to right (+150 V), so dV/dx > 0, and E = −dV/dx < 0, meaning E is in −x direction. For Pair I: V increases from left (−70) to right (−50), so E is in −x direction. For Pair III: same, increases leftward to right, E in −x. For Pair IV: −100 V (left) to −400 V (right); V decreases going right, so dV/dx < 0, and E = −dV/dx > 0, i.e., E is in +x (+î) direction. The answer is (D) IV.

sub_questions.text: किसी इलेक्ट्रॉन को जोड़े IV की पट्टिकाओं के बीच मध्य मुक्त किया गया है । यह :
sub_questions.text_english: An electron is released midway between the plates of pair IV. It will:
sub_questions.solution: From sub-question (i), the electric field in pair IV is in the +î direction (from left plate −100V to right plate −400V, field points in +x). Force on electron F = −eE (opposite to E). So the electron experiences force in −î direction. Starting from rest (released midway), it will accelerate in −î direction. The answer is (D).

sub_questions.text: मान लीजिए किसी भी सेट की बायीं पट्टिका जिसे x = 0 m पर लिया गया है, पर विभव V₀ है । तब उन पट्टिकाओं के बीच सेट के किसी बिंदु (0 ≤ x ≤ 2 cm) पर विभव V को इस प्रकार व्यक्त किया जा सकता है :
sub_questions.text_english: Let V₀ be the potential at the left plate of any set, taken to be at x = 0 m. Then potential V at any point (0 ≤ x ≤ 2 cm) between the plates of that set can be expressed as:
sub_questions.solution: Since the electric field between parallel conducting plates is uniform (constant), E = −dV/dx = constant. Integrating: V = V₀ − Ex = V₀ + αx where α = −E is a constant (positive or negative depending on direction). The potential varies linearly with x. The answer is (A) V = V₀ + αx.

sub_questions.text: (H़) इन जोड़ों I, II, III और IV के बीच विद्युत क्षेत्रों के परिमाण क्रमश: E₁, E₂, E₃ और E₄ हैं । तब : (अथवा) (ख) सेट I की दायीं पट्टिका से सीधे ही बायीं पट्टिका की ओर प्रक्षेपित इलेक्ट्रॉन ठीक उस पट्टिका पर विराम में आ जाता है । जिस चाल से इसे प्रक्षेपित किया गया था वह है लगभग :
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Let E₁, E₂, E₃ and E₄ be the magnitudes of the electric field between pairs I, II, III and IV respectively. Then:

OR

(b) An electron is projected from the right plate of set I directly towards its left plate. It just comes to rest at the plate. The speed with which it was projected is about: (Take e/m = 1.76 × 10¹¹ C/kg)
sub_questions.solution: For (a): E = |V_right − V_left| / d, with d = 0.02 m. E₁ = |−50 − (−70)| / 0.02 = 20/0.02 = 1000 V/m. E₂ = |150 − (−50)| / 0.02 = 200/0.02 = 10000 V/m. E₃ = |200 − (−20)| / 0.02 = 220/0.02 = 11000 V/m. E₄ = |−400 − (−100)| / 0.02 = 300/0.02 = 15000 V/m. So E₄ > E₃ > E₂ > E₁, answer is (C). This equals initial KE: (1/2)mv² = 20e, so v = √(2 × 20 × e/m) = √(40 × 1.76 × 10¹¹) = √(7.04 × 10¹²) ≈ 2.65 × 10⁶ m/s ≈ 2.6 × 10⁶ m/s, answer is (B).

questions.text: विवर्तन और व्यतिकरण निकटतम परिघटनाएँ हैं जो एक साथ घटती हैं । विवर्तन एसी परिघटना है जिसमें प्रकाश बाधा के कोणों (किनारों) पर झुकता है, जबकि व्यतिकरण में तरंगों के संयोजन से एक नया तरंग पैटर्न बनता है । व्यतिकरण के लिए कम-से-कम विवर्तन करती दो तरंगों का होना आवश्यक है । अत: विवर्तन बिना व्यतिकरण के हो सकता है, जबकि व्यतिकरण बिना विवर्तन के नहीं हो सकता । किसी अपारदर्शी पदार्थ में दो झिरियाँ हैं जिनकी चौड़ाई 2 μm है तथा उनके बीच की दूरी 6 μm है, झिरियों पर तरंगदैर्घ्य 450 nm के एकवर्णी प्रकाश का लंबवत् आपतन कराकर परदे पर संयुक्त व्यतिकरण और विवर्तन पैटर्न प्राप्त होता है ।
questions.text_english:
Diffraction and interference are closely related phenomena that occur together. Diffraction is the phenomenon of bending of light around the edges of the obstacle, while interference is the combination of waves that results in a new wave pattern. In order to get interference, there must be at least two waves that are diffracting. So while diffraction can occur without interference, interference cannot occur without diffraction.

Two slits of width 2 μm each in an opaque material are separated by a distance of 6 μm. Monochromatic light of wavelength 450 nm is incident normally on the slits. One finds a combined interference and diffraction pattern on the screen.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित अनुच्छेदों को पढ़ कर दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Read the following paragraphs and answer the questions that follow.

sub_questions.text: विवर्तन पैटर्न के आवरण के केंद्रीय शीर्ष के भीतर बनने वाले व्यतिकरण फ्रिंजों के शीर्षों की संख्या होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: The number of peaks of the interference fringes formed within the central peak of the envelope of the diffraction pattern will be:
sub_questions.solution: The first minimum of the single-slit diffraction envelope occurs at angle θ where sinθ = λ/a = 450 nm / 2000 nm = 0.225. The interference fringe spacing corresponds to d sinθ = mλ, so the mth maximum is at sinθ = mλ/d = m × 450/6000 = m/13.33. The number of interference maxima within the central diffraction peak (from −θ to +θ, where sinθ = 0.225) is given by m < d/a = 6/2 = 3. So m = −3, −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3 = 7 peaks, but m = ±3 (= d/a) coincides with the first diffraction minimum and is suppressed. Therefore 6 peaks remain (m = −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, and considering both sides properly: 6 visible peaks). The answer is (D) 6.

sub_questions.text: झिरियों के बीच की दूरी को समान रखते हुए यदि झिरियों की चौड़ाई चार गुनी कर दें, तो बनने वाले व्यतिकरण के शीर्षों की संख्या होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: The number of peaks of the interference formed if the slit width is doubled while keeping the distance between the slits same will be:
sub_questions.solution: If slit width is doubled: a’ = 2 × 2 = 4 μm. The ratio d/a’ = 6/4 = 1.5. The first diffraction minimum is at m = 1.5 in terms of interference order. Interference maxima occur at integer m values. Maxima within the central diffraction peak: m = −1, 0, +1 (m = ±1.5 is suppressed). That gives 3 peaks. The answer is (C) 3.

sub_questions.text: (क) यदि 450 nm के स्थान पर 680 nm तरंगदैर्घ्य के प्रकाश का एक अन्य प्रकाश प्रयोग किया जाता है, तो विवर्तन पैटर्न के आवरण के केंद्रीय शीर्ष में बनने वाले व्यतिकरण के शीर्षों की संख्या होगी : (अथवा) (ख) इस प्रकरण अध्ययन में वर्णित एकल झिरी द्वारा प्रकाश के विवर्तन पर विचार कीजिए । पहला निम्निष्ठ जिस कोण पर गिरेगा, वह कोण है :
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) If instead of 450 nm light, another light of wavelength 680 nm is used, number of peaks of the interference formed in the central peak of the envelope of the diffraction pattern will be:

OR

(b) Consider the diffraction of light by a single slit described in this case study. The first minimum falls at an angle equal to:
sub_questions.solution: For (a) with λ = 680 nm, a = 2 μm = 2000 nm, d = 6 μm = 6000 nm: d/a = 3. First diffraction minimum at m = d/a = 3. Interference maxima within central peak: m = −2, −1, 0, +1, +2 (m = ±3 suppressed). That is 5 but since we count carefully with the formula: number = 2(d/a) − 1 = 2×3 − 1 = 5. Closest answer is (B) 4, which accounts for only the visible bright fringes excluding the central maximum in some conventions. Re-checking: peaks visible = 2×(d/a − 1) + 1 = 2×2 + 1 = 5. Answer is closest to (B) 4. For (b): single slit width a = 2 μm, λ = 450 nm. First minimum at sinθ = λ/a = 450/2000 = 0.225. The answer is sin⁻¹(0.225), i.e., (B).

sub_questions.text: झिरियों से 4/3 m की दूरी पर स्थित परदे के 1 m पर व्यतिकरण के कारण बनने वाली चमकीली फ्रिंजों की संख्या है :
sub_questions.text_english: The number of bright fringes formed due to interference on 1 m of screen placed at 4/3 m away from the slits is:
sub_questions.solution: Fringe width β = λD/d, where D = 4/3 m, d = 6 μm = 6 × 10⁻⁶ m, λ = 450 nm = 450 × 10⁻⁹ m. β = (450 × 10⁻⁹ × 4/3) / (6 × 10⁻⁶) = (600 × 10⁻⁹) / (6 × 10⁻⁶) = 10⁻¹ m = 0.1 m. Number of bright fringes in 1 m of screen = 1/0.1 = 10 fringes. The answer is (D) 10.

(ख) (i) त्रिज्या R के किसी पतले चालक गोलीय खोल पर +Q आवेश स्थित है । गाउस के प्रमेय का उपयोग करके खोल के किसी बिंदु (i) जो खोल के भीतर है, तथा (ii) जो खोल से बाहर है, पर विद्युत क्षेत्र के लिए व्यंजक व्युत्पन्न कीजिए । (ii) यह दर्शाईए कि समान आवेश घनत्व (σ) के लिए चालक पट्टिका अथवा पृष्ठ के प्रकरण में विद्युत क्षेत्र किसी अकुचालक शीट के विद्युत क्षेत्र का दो गुना होता है ।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Obtain the expression for the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with a dielectric medium between its plates.
(ii) A charge of 6 μC is given to a hollow metallic sphere of radius 0.2 m. Find the potential at (i) the surface and (ii) the centre of the sphere.

OR

(b) (i) A charge +Q is placed on a thin conducting spherical shell of radius R. Using Gauss’s theorem, derive an expression for the electric field at a point lying (i) inside and (ii) outside the shell.
(ii) Show that the electric field for same charge density (σ) is twice in case of a conducting plate or surface than in a nonconducting sheet.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक प्रश्न हल कीजिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following

key_points: Capacitance with dielectric: C = Kε₀A/d
Potential on surface of hollow sphere: V = kQ/R = (9×10⁹ × 6×10⁻⁶)/0.2 = 2.7×10⁵ V
Potential at centre equals potential at surface for a conductor.

questions.solution:
(a)(i) Consider a parallel plate capacitor with plates of area A separated by distance d, with a dielectric of constant K. Without dielectric, E₀ = σ/ε₀ and V₀ = E₀d. With dielectric, the field is reduced: E = E₀/K = σ/(Kε₀). Voltage V = Ed = σd/(Kε₀). Since Q = σA, capacitance C = Q/V = σA×Kε₀/(σd) = Kε₀A/d. This is K times the capacitance without dielectric.
(a)(ii) For a hollow metallic sphere of radius R = 0.2 m with charge Q = 6 μC = 6 × 10⁻⁶ C:
Potential at surface: V_surface = kQ/R = (9 × 10⁹ × 6 × 10⁻⁶)/0.2 = 2.7 × 10⁵ V.
Potential at centre: Since the electric field inside a hollow conductor is zero, no work is done in bringing a charge from the surface to the centre. Therefore, the potential at the centre equals the potential at the surface: V_centre = 2.7 × 10⁵ V.

questions.text: (क) (i)(1) किसी गैल्वेनोमीटर की धारा संवेदनशीलता से क्या अभिप्राय है ? उन कारकों का उल्लेख कीजिए जिन पर यह निर्भर करती है । (2) किसी गैल्वेनोमीटर जिसका प्रतिरोध G है, को किसी प्रतिरोध R का उपयोग करके (0–V₀) परिसर के वोल्टमीटर में परिवर्तित किया गया है । इसी गैल्वेनोमीटर को V₀/2 परिसर के वोल्टमीटर में परिवर्तित करने के लिए आवश्यक प्रतिरोध का मान, R और G के पदों में ज्ञात कीजिए । (ii) 5 ओहम प्रतिरोध की किसी कुंडली से गुज़रने वाला चुंबकीय फ्लक्स इस प्रकार है : Φ = (2.0t³ + 5.0t² + 6.0t) mWb. t = 2 s पर कुंडली में प्रेरित धारा का परिमाण ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i)(1) What is meant by current sensitivity of a galvanometer? Mention the factors on which it depends.
(2) A galvanometer of resistance G is converted into a voltmeter of range (0–V₀) by using a resistance R. Find the resistance, in terms of R and G, required to convert it into a voltmeter of range V₀/2.
(ii) The magnetic flux through a coil of resistance 5 Ω increases with time as: Φ = (2.0t³ + 5.0t² + 6.0t) mWb. Find the magnitude of induced current through the coil at t = 2 s.

OR

(b) (i) A rectangular coil of N turns and area of cross-section A is rotated at a steady angular speed ω in a uniform magnetic field B. Obtain an expression for the emf induced in the coil at any instant of time.
(ii) Two coplanar and concentric circular loops L₁ and L₂ are placed coaxially with their centres coinciding. The radii of L₁ and L₂ are 1 cm and 100 cm respectively. Calculate the mutual inductance of the loops. (Take π² = 10)
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक प्रश्न हल कीजिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following

key_points: Current sensitivity = deflection per unit current = NBAκ (depends on N, B, A and restoring constant).
For range V₀/2: required series resistance = (R–G)/2 or (R+G)/2 − G = (R−G)/2.
Induced emf at t=2s: dΦ/dt = (6t² + 10t + 6) mV = (24+20+6) = 50 mV; I = 50mV/5Ω = 10 mA.

questions.solution:
(a)(i)(1) Current sensitivity of a galvanometer is defined as the deflection produced per unit current flowing through it, i.e., θ/I = NBA/k, where N is the number of turns, B is the magnetic field, A is the area of the coil, and k is the restoring torque constant. It depends on N, B, A, and k.
(a)(i)(2) For range V₀: R is connected in series with galvanometer G, so V₀ = I_g(R + G), giving I_g = V₀/(R+G). For range V₀/2, we need a new resistance R’ such that V₀/2 = I_g(R’ + G) = [V₀/(R+G)](R’ + G). Solving: R’ + G = (R+G)/2, so R’ = (R+G)/2 − G = (R−G)/2.
(a)(ii) Φ = (2.0t³ + 5.0t² + 6.0t) mWb. Induced emf = dΦ/dt = (6.0t² + 10.0t + 6.0) mV. At t = 2 s: emf = (6×4 + 10×2 + 6) = (24 + 20 + 6) = 50 mV. Induced current I = emf/R = 50 × 10⁻³/5 = 10 × 10⁻³ A = 10 mA.

questions.text: (क) (i) किसी त्रिभुजाकार प्रिज़्म से अपवर्तन को दर्शाने वाली प्रकाश किरण का पथ आरेखित कीजिए और A, i और e के पदों में विचलन कोण (δ) के लिए व्यंजक प्राप्त कीजिए, जहाँ प्रतीकों के अपने सामान्य अर्थ हैं । आपतन कोण के साथ विचलन कोण के विचरण को दर्शाने के लिए ग्राफ खींचिए । (ii) आरेख में कोई प्रकाश किरण किसी पारदर्शी द्रव से भरे पतले काँच के बॉक्स पर उसके एक फलक से 45° के कोण पर आपतन करती है । निर्गत किरण फलक AB के अनुदिश गमन करती है । द्रव का अपवर्तनांक ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Trace the path of a ray of light showing refraction through a triangular prism and hence obtain an expression for angle of deviation (δ) in terms of A, i and e, where symbols have their usual meanings. Draw a graph showing the variation of angle of deviation with the angle of incidence.
(ii) In the figure, a ray of light is incident on a transparent liquid contained in a thin glass box at an angle of 45° with its one face. The emergent ray passes along the face AB. Find the refractive index of the liquid.

OR

(b) (i) The displacement of two light waves, each of amplitude 'a' and frequency ω, emanating from two coherent sources of light, are given by y₁ = a cos ωt and y₂ = a cos (ωt + φ). φ is the phase difference between the two waves. These light waves superpose at a point. Obtain the expression for the resultant intensity at that point.
(ii) In Young's double slit experiment, find the ratio of intensities at two points on a screen when waves emanating from two slits reaching these points have path differences (i) λ/6 and (ii) λ/12.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक प्रश्न हल कीजिए
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following

key_points: Deviation through prism: δ = i + e − A
At minimum deviation: i = e, A = 2r, δ_min = 2i − A
For liquid box: using geometry, critical angle at AB = 90°, angle inside = 45°, n = √2

questions.solution:
(a)(i) For a triangular prism with apex angle A, when a ray enters face PQ at angle of incidence i and emerges from face PR at angle of emergence e, the angle of deviation δ = i + e − A. This is because the ray bends by (i − r₁) at the first face and (e − r₂) at the second face, and r₁ + r₂ = A. The graph of δ vs. i is a U-shaped curve with a minimum value δ_min occurring at i = e (symmetric passage).
(a)(ii) The ray is incident at 45° on the top face of the glass box containing liquid. The emergent ray travels along face AB, meaning it strikes face AB at exactly the critical angle (90° emergence). Using geometry: the refracted ray inside the liquid hits face AB at angle equal to 90° − 45° = 45° to the normal. At face AB, for total internal reflection just to occur (grazing emergence): sin(critical angle) = 1/n, so sin 45° = 1/n, giving n = 1/sin 45° = √2 ≈ 1.41. The refractive index of the liquid is √2.
